kind: stage0 Store primitive author implementation/selftests; independent root review pending

API.PrepareAccepted: (AcceptedSettlement) (AcceptedPreparation,error). Locks Store, computes current disposition/projected draft, clones capture and preview, never writes entries/settled/stamp.
API.AcceptedPreparation: Private store/entry identity, entry causal mutation scalar, exact captured request/capture and expected state. No issued-ticket registry or second request ledger. Expected() returns value fields; Preview() returns deep-cloned CommitResult.
API.Expected: DocumentID, current binding Epoch/Hot, SurfaceRevision/SemanticRevision/SemanticDigest, FenceAfter/Invalid/Marked/Error. Captured original Epoch is separately bound in full request capture.
API.CommitPreparedAccepted: (accepted, preparation) -> CommitResult/error. Zero/foreign/stale/mismatched ticket fails before any mutation. Compares full capture (doc, epoch, semantic rev/digest, canonical, runs, attachment IDs), private Store/entry, monotonic causal scalar and expected state.
API.CommitAccepted: Original signature retained; performs same preparation+commit under one mutex for old direct Store callers. No source callers or production wiring changed.
API.dispositions: AlreadySettled checked before invalid/marked: callers must skip native. Deferred means no settled marker/no body change. Conflicting sameRequest semantic digest errors as before. Actionable Changed/Preserved preview includes resulting semantic document and RemovedUTF16.
API.causalScalar: One uint64 per document invalidates across Bind (even idempotent), accepted snapshots/fence/conflict/retirement/settlement, including ABA with unchanged visible header. Other documents and repeated pure Prepare calls do not invalidate a ticket.
API.ledgerCompatibility: Existing entry.settled remains requestID→semanticDigest exactly as before. A fresh duplicate request with same semantic digest remains AlreadySettled even if its capture attachment IDs/epoch differ; wire payload identity/conflict belongs to existing transport ledger. A previously issued preparation cannot be borrowed with changed attachment IDs/epoch.

coverage: Repeated Prepare does not mutate/invalidate either ticket; discarding unused preparation never marks settled.
Cold accepted→rebind→retype identical canonical/new occurrence→duplicate prepares AlreadySettled; native side-effect counter stays0, including later current invalid fence.
Marked/invalid defer and commit deferred without any settled/body mutation; recovery invalidates old ticket and permits new preparation.
Simulated native CAS failure discards ticket; Store unchanged and next preflight actionable. No actual native operation executed.

Stale tickets rejected after Bind/sameEpochBind, RetireDocument/Account/Window, Marked/Fence, sameDigest newer revision, sameCanonical fresh occurrence, same binding ABA and accepted same-frame state.

Full request/capture replacement (request ID, document, captured epoch, semantic rev, canonical, attachment IDs, runs+digest) cannot reuse a preparation. Original ticket remains valid after mismatched commit rejection.
Returned preview/document/run mutations and original caller Runs/AttachmentIDs changes cannot alter sealed preparation; returned CommitResult cannot mutate Store.
Zero/foreign-store preparation rejected. Existing direct CommitAccepted and sameRequest semantic-conflict behavior preserved.
Unrelated document mutations do not invalidate the target document ticket.

integrationBoundary.noExternalAtomicityPromise: Preparation is only a local CAS primitive. It neither reserves native state nor proves an AppKit operation. A future single-UI-thread adapter must preflight, skip AlreadySettled/Deferred, run semantic native CAS, commit with the exact ticket, then reconcile full native snapshot. Do not Store.Accept the post-native snapshot before CommitPrepared or it invalidates the ticket.
integrationBoundary.failedNativeCAS: No cancellation/rollback call is needed because Prepare is pure; do not call commit when native CAS fails.
integrationBoundary.pendingColdNativeReconciliation: Not implemented: valid A left→Store cold receipt clears its prefix→saved native A still holds that prefix. On activation, do not Accept stale native body and revive sent text. Also do not bypass AlreadySettled and delete a later newly typed occurrence. Future adapter needs departure baseline plus exact cold-settlement native CAS/cut-undo before ordinary snapshot adoption; test cold commit→hot return→retype→duplicate end-to-end.
integrationBoundary.pendingHotActivation: remote_wire owns separate Swift/Editor bounded hot-activation. No ack parser, Store Bind/Fence adapter, main composer, image/paste/drop/height/focus/IME, transport or receipt wiring added here.
integrationBoundary.notARealRemoteSend: All writes are local in-memory fixtures; local accepted settlement is not a real Host submission acceptance.

git.sourceCommit: paused by root: composer_native baseline remains untracked, so partial Store commit would not build in a clean checkout. Preserve checkpoint; after parallel hot-activation and joint root review, select complete component baseline+both slices, excluding App/Proof/build.

limitations: Author Go selftests, not independent acceptance; root will run ticket counterexamples.
No AppKit/window/GUI/package/sign/notary action, real Host write, physical IME or M1/performance measurement.
Actual Swift digest gate remains skipped without its explicit result environment; no claim that Swift was recompiled/tested in this Go-only slice.
